name: Costco Food Court Chicken Bake (Eat Warm Bread & Chicken Center)
brandOrRestaurant: Costco Wholesale Food Court (Logan / Lehi / South Jordan / Sandy, UT)
whyItWorks: Soft baked pizza-dough crust filled with tender chicken breast strips, bacon, provolone, mozzarella, and parmesan; zero insoluble vegetable roughage, though rich in cheese and Caesar dressing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Share half a Chicken Bake for a quick remission lunch, take a lactase enzyme for the mozzarella/Caesar filling, and brush off any charred parmesan crust bits.
watchOuts: Contains Caesar dressing (garlic/soybean oil) and melted mozzarella—save for remission and take lactase
